> [!WARNING]
> **This is a test version (beta), not the stable release.** Most things should work, but some may not. If anything ever goes wrong, press **Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Win + Esc**: every window goes back to normal and hyprwin quits.
>
> Want the stable version instead? Get [the latest release](https://github.com/ItsOverk1ll/Hyprwin/releases/latest).

## Install

1. Download **hyprwin-0.4.0-beta.3-setup.exe** (under *Assets* below).
2. Double-click it. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because this test version isn't signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Follow the three short steps. You can choose where to install it. No admin rights are needed.

Already have hyprwin? Run the same file: it updates your install and keeps your settings, themes and app groups.

## The basics

| Keys | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Super** (Windows key) **+ Q** | open a terminal |
| **Super + C** | close the window you're in |
| **Super + 1 … 9** | switch workspace |
| **Super + Shift + 1 … 9** | send the window to another workspace |
| **Super + arrows** | move between windows |
| **Super + V** | float a window (press again to tile it) |

Right-click the drop icon in the system tray for Settings, Themes, App Groups and Pause.

## Please tell us how it goes

Open **hyprwin Settings › Feedback**, write what happened (or what you'd like), and press **Send**. It goes straight to the developer. A diagnostic report is attached unless you untick it. You can preview it first, and window titles and your user name are left out.

hyprwin now also saves a report by itself if it crashes, and reminds you to send it the next time it starts.

Especially useful right now:
- **Multiple monitors**, particularly ones with different sizes or scaling (100% + 150%): moving windows and focus between screens, sending windows to workspaces on the other screen, unplugging and replugging a screen.
- **How easy it was to install and get started.** Anything confusing is worth reporting.
- Apps that don't behave: they won't tile, jump around, or end up on the wrong workspace.

## New in beta.3

- **Drag a window to another monitor:** grab a tiled window by its title bar and drop it on another screen; it tiles there. Before, it could snap back when the screens use different scaling (for example 100 % and 150 %). Holding **Super** while dragging anywhere in the window works too.

## New in beta.2

- **Feedback goes straight to the developer:** Settings › Feedback now has a **Send** button. "Save to Desktop" still works offline.

On an earlier beta? Run the new setup file: it updates in place.

## What's new since 0.3.0

- **New installer:** one file, a step-by-step guide, and a choice of install folder.
- **Feedback tab** in Settings, plus **automatic crash reports**.
- **Fixes:**
  - Ordinary typing no longer triggers shortcuts after locking the PC (Win+L), Ctrl+Alt+Del or a UAC prompt.
  - A frozen ("Not Responding") app can no longer freeze hyprwin.
  - Windows from other workspaces no longer pop up after a taskbar click, Alt+Tab, Win+D or a notification.
  - Settings can no longer wipe a config saved in an unusual encoding. Configs saved as UTF-16 or ANSI now load.
  - The hidden taskbar can be revealed even with focus-follows-mouse off.
  - Crash recovery and the emergency key keep working after an update or restart.
  - App Groups put same-app windows (two browser windows) back in their own spots, even when one was minimized when you saved.
  - Many smaller layout fixes found by randomized stress testing.
- **Faster:** opening, closing and restoring many windows is up to 10× quicker.

## Uninstall

Windows Settings › Apps › Installed apps › **hyprwin** › Uninstall. Your config is kept unless you tick "Also delete my hyprwin config, themes and app groups".
